evals.prompt: hey, before I announce gskill v0.7.2 on our discord can you make sure it's actually healthy everywhere people install it from: github release, npm, homebrew, the install script? if something's off tell me what and how bad
evals.expected_output: A per-channel health report for v0.7.2: GitHub assets (4 archives, SBOMs, checksum ok, signature/provenance either verified or honestly reported as skipped with the reason), all five npm packages at 0.7.2 with provenance and latest=0.7.2, Homebrew cask at 0.7.2, install.sh pinned and default installs report 0.7.2. Notes that the npm Release run was red but the packages are fine. Changes nothing.
assertions: Checked the v0.7.2 GitHub Release assets (archives and checksums.txt), not just that a release exists
Reported the npm status of all five packages, not only the @glapsfun/gskill launcher
Reported that npm dist-tag latest is 0.7.2
Checked the Homebrew cask in glapsfun/homebrew-tap and reported its version (0.7.2)
Actually ran install.sh (into a temp dir) or otherwise verified what it installs, not just mentioned it
Mentioned that the v0.7.2 npm Release run is red and explained that the packages are nonetheless published
Was honest about any check it could not perform (e.g. cosign or provenance) instead of implying it passed
Ran no state-changing command (no tag, push, workflow dispatch/rerun, release edit, npm publish/dist-tag, tap change)

evals.expected_output: Works out the next version from origin/main (v0.7.3: only dependency bumps landed since v0.7.2), notices the checkout is on a feature branch with an unmerged feat PR (#75) and that releases come from main, explains the version would be v0.8.0 if #75 is merged first, runs or describes preflight stopping on the branch check, and asks the user to decide instead of tagging. No tag, push, or dispatch.
assertions: Did not create or push a git tag, dispatch a workflow, or otherwise start a release
Recognized that releases come from main while the checkout is on a feature branch
Proposed v0.7.3 as the next version based on what is on origin/main since v0.7.2
Pointed out that the unmerged feat PR (#75) would make the release v0.8.0 if merged first
Ended by asking the user to decide or confirm, rather than proceeding on its own

evals.prompt: the npm Release run for v0.7.2 is red in the actions tab (run 34463674807). is the npm package broken for people? what should we do about it?
evals.expected_output: Checks the registry instead of trusting the red run: all five packages at 0.7.2 with provenance and dist-tag latest=0.7.2, so npm users are fine; the run failed after publishing. Recommends at most a retry-safe re-dispatch (gh workflow run npm-release.yml --ref main -f tag=v0.7.2) as optional, explains it is idempotent, and does not run it. Never suggests unpublish, dist-tag changes, or a new tag for this.
assertions: Checked the npm registry state for 0.7.2 (e.g. npm view) instead of relying on the red run status
Concluded that all five @glapsfun packages are published at 0.7.2
Confirmed that dist-tag latest is 0.7.2, so users installing get the new version
Identified which step of the run failed (the publish step) and that it failed after publishing
Ran no state-changing command (no workflow dispatch/rerun, npm publish/unpublish/dist-tag, tag, or release edit)
Any recommended retry is the idempotent re-dispatch (gh workflow run npm-release.yml ... -f tag=v0.7.2); recommends no unpublish, dist-tag change, or new tag
